name: BYToken permissionless auto-burn of the pair reserve
summary: BYToken's public triggerAutoBurn() burned 1% of total supply per elapsed interval from the BY/WBNB pair, regardless of the pair's own reserve, then synced it. With flash-borrowed WBNB the attacker opened trading, bought the pair's BY down to just above the burn amount, triggered the burn so 1 wei of BY remained, and sold dust BY for all the pair's WBNB.
notes: setPool replaced the constructor's placeholder pool (the deployer EOA) with the BY/WBNB pair, the address _autoBurn burns from and syncs; the vulnerable burn of the pair's reserve existed only from this write. The trading auto-enable the attacker reached is a gate, not a reset.
